mapper.select: select scls_cd , scls_nm from lib_cls lc where mcls_cd = 'c0010' or mcls_cd = 'c0020' or mcls_cd = 'c0030'
select scls_cd from lib_cls where scls_nm like concat('', #{ctgNm} ,'')

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT f.bk_file_ori_name FROM lib_file_book f WHERE b.book_id = f.book_id), '') AS file_name, b.book_id, title, author, b.ctg_id, c.scls_nm AS ctg_nm, publisher, cheonggu, isbn FROM lib_books b INNER JOIN lib_cls c ON c.scls_cd = b.ctg_id where (title like CONCAT('%', #{sKey}, '%') or author like CONCAT('%', #{sKey}, '%')) order by book_id desc limit #{recordCountPerPage} offset #{firstIndex}
select count(*) from lib_books b where (title like CONCAT('%', #{sKey}, '%') or author like CONCAT('%', #{sKey}, '%'))
mapper.insert: insert into lib_books(book_id, title, author, ctg_id, publisher, cheonggu, isbn) values ( #{bookId}, #{title}, #{author}, #{ctgId}, #{publisher}, #{cheonggu}, #{isbn} )
mapper.update: update lib_books set title = #{title}, author = #{author}, ctg_id = #{ctgId}, publisher = #{publisher}, cheonggu = #{cheonggu}, isbn = #{isbn} where book_id = #{bookId}
mapper.select: select bk_file_path from lib_file_book where book_id = #{id}
